claim: Building AndBible on Sage requires `git submodule update --init jsword` (otherwise Gradle fails with the misleading 'No matching variant of project :jsword' error), running gradlew with dangerouslyDisableSandbox because the Gradle daemon breaks in Claude Code's sandbox, and a user-space toolchain (Temurin JDK17 in ~/tools/jdk17, Android cmdline-tools + sdkmanager, sdk.dir in local.properties) with no sudo.
trigger: before running ./gradlew in the AndBible repo on Sage
when Gradle fails with 'No matching variant of project :jsword / No variants exist'
when checking an AndBible background build's success (grep the log for BUILD SUCCESSFUL; piping through tail masks failures)

claim: AndBible debug builds already apply applicationIdSuffix '.debug' by default in app/build.gradle.kts, so they install alongside the store app without setting APP_SUFFIX in local.properties, and on Sage port 8000 is taken by a uvicorn service so ad-hoc HTTP serving (e.g. APK delivery) should use another port like 8765.
trigger: before setting APP_SUFFIX in AndBible's local.properties
when installing an AndBible debug APK alongside the Play-store app
when picking a port for ad-hoc `python3 -m http.server` on Sage

claim: AndBible's LlmUtils.kt hardcodes the Anthropic provider with supportsDynamicModels=false, only three stale models (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6), and Opus pricing at $15/$75 per MTok versus the actual $5/$25, so its in-app cost tracker overstates Opus spend about 3x and current-gen models are unselectable without code changes.
trigger: when reading AndBible's in-app Anthropic cost tracker
when trying to select an Anthropic model inside AndBible
when weighing fork-vs-build for the havruta AndBible fork
